recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic, cool-toned group portrait featuring three figures in oversized pinstripe suits posed in front of a vintage 1940s-style sedan. The scene is bathed in a heavy blue-cyan atmospheric tint, contrasting with warm-toned, tall condensed lettering at the top and stylized wide-spaced type at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Triangular group composition with a central dominant figure
Contrast between sharp pinstripe patterns and soft atmospheric haze
Juxtaposition of masculine-coded tailoring with feminine styling
Color tension between the cool blue environment and warm red/orange title text
coreInvariants: Heavy cyan/blue color grade across the entire photographic plate
Oversized double-breasted pinstripe blazers and wide-leg trousers
Presence of a black vintage automobile as a secondary backdrop element
High-contrast lighting creating deep shadows and bright highlights on skin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects occupy the center and mid-ground, scaled to fill approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure with crossed arms serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large top-left title, move down the central figure's vertical pinstripes, and settle on the wide-spaced subtitle at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open urban ground in the foreground and a hazy, bright sky-like background provide breathing room for the subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Steel blue and cyan (environment, clothing, shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low color variety; the image is nearly monochromatic except for the text.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a consistent blue wash over skin tones

letterConstructionRules: Top text: Extreme vertical elongation, narrow widths, tight kerning
Bottom text: Wide tracking, geometric forms, high contrast between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' in the top text features a high crossbar
The 'R' and 'G' in the bottom text have stylized, open curves
graphicDevices: Drop shadows for legibility against busy backgrounds

preserve: Extreme verticality of the main title
Wide letter spacing of the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, bold feel of the top title
Captures the geometric, wide-spaced feel of the bottom text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast photo of three women in oversized 90s pinstripe suits and ties, standing in front of a black vintage 1940s sedan on a city street. Apply a heavy cyan-blue color grade to the entire image. The lighting should be bright but diffused, creating a hazy urban noir atmosphere.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, vertically stretched sans-serif title in the top left corner using a warm orange-red gradient with a thin black outline. Add a smaller, wide-spaced geometric subtitle at the bottom center in white with a subtle black drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette dominated by cyan and blue tones?
Are the pinstripe patterns clearly visible on the suits?
Is the top text significantly more vertically elongated than the bottom text?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue color grade
Specific model of the vintage car
Degree of vertical stretch on the primary title
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or faces
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the blue tint does not wash out the pinstripe details.
Check that the red text provides a strong visual pop against the blue.
Verify the triangular composition of the subjects.
Confirm the vintage car is recognizable but secondary.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine 90s power-suit fashion with 1940s noir elements under a heavy cyan filter, topped with high-contrast typographic layouts.
